# cli

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/api/cli"
```

Package cli configures the public trustyca command, client connections and output formatting.

Cli.AfterApply changes process\-wide xlog and time formatting, so CLIs are never parsed concurrently in one process; the test suites of api/cli/command are not parallel for that reason.

<a name="Cli"></a>
## type [Cli](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/cli/cli.go#L45-L70>)

Cli provides CLI context to run commands

```go
type Cli struct {
    Server  string          `short:"s" help:"Address of the remote server to connect.  Use TRUSTYCA_SERVER environment to override"`
    Debug   bool            `short:"D" help:"Enable debug mode"`
    Version ctl.VersionFlag `name:"version" help:"Print version information and quit" hidden:""`
    O       string          `help:"Print output format: json|yaml"`
    Cfg     string          `help:"Configuration file" default:"~/.config/trustyca/config.yaml"`
    Storage string          `help:"flag specifies to override default location: ~/.trustyca. Use TRUSTYCA_STORAGE environment to override"`
    HTTP    bool            `short:"H" help:"Use HTTP client"`

    TimeFormat string `name:"time" help:"Print time format: utc|local|ago" hidden:"" default:"utc"`

    Timeout   int    `help:"Connection timeout"  default:"6"`
    TrustedCA string `short:"r" help:"Trusted CA store for server TLS"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Cli.AfterApply"></a>
### func \(\*Cli\) [AfterApply](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/cli/cli.go#L137>)

```go
func (c *Cli) AfterApply(app *kong.Kong, vars kong.Vars) error
```

AfterApply hook loads config. It sets the process\-wide log formatter, log level and time format, so two CLIs must not be parsed concurrently in one process.
